svg.aria-label: Breadboard wiring for the LED and button
svg.text: Breadboard view: Teensy across the trench, parts to the right
Top view, USB to the left. The pins sit in rows 4 and 8, leaving 3 free holes above and 2 below each pin
1. GND (col 1) to the bottom − rail; top GND (col 2) to the top − rail.
2. Pin 2 (col 4) to col 26: the button. Its diagonal leg (col 28, top half) goes to the − rail.
3. Pin 11 (col 13) to col 30, R1 470 Ω from col 30 to 34, LED long leg col 34, short leg col 35, col 35 to −.
